exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
exercises.notes: Foundation for shoulders. The closer your feet are to your hands, the harder.

technique.text: Place your feet as close to your hands as possible — your body forms an inverted V. Lower your head straight down between your hands, elbows slightly out.

exercises.name: Bench Dips
exercises.notes: The "king" of exercises for the lower chest and triceps.

technique.text: Lean forward to work the chest more. Stay vertical to target the triceps more. Don't flare your elbows too wide.

exercises.name: Decline Push-ups
exercises.notes: Feet elevated to emphasize the upper chest.

technique.text: Feet on a chair or bed. The higher your feet, the more load on the upper chest and front delts. Keep your body straight.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.notes: Elbows tucked to your body. Triceps isolation.

progression.name: Close-grip Push-ups
progression.description: Hands close together, but not a diamond

progression.name: Diamond Push-ups + Pause
progression.description: With a 2s pause at the bottom

technique.text: Hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond. Elbows move straight back along your body. Pause for 1 second at the bottom.
